name: NetBSD
summary: NetBSD presumes code generated by large language models or similar tools to be tainted. Such code must not be committed without prior written approval from core.

evidence.quote: Code generated by a large language model or similar technology, such as GitHub/Microsoft's Copilot, OpenAI's ChatGPT, or Facebook/Meta's Code Llama, is presumed to be tainted code, and must not be committed without prior written approval by core.

rules.note: AI-generated code is presumed tainted and must not be committed unless core gives prior written approval.
